payload.name: Search Relationship and Naming Events for Group Members
payload.description: When a question asks for the names of a person's pets, family, or group members and the first search returns activity memories without names, include relationship memories and search naming/acquisition events.
content: When a question asks for the names or identities of a person's pets, family, or group members, include relationship memory kinds (pet, family, member_of) in the search, not only event and state.

If the first search returns activity memories without names, run targeted searches for acquisition or definition events such as adopted, bought, received, named, or welcomed, combined with the person and the entity type.
Answer only from retrieved evidence; if only some names are supported, report those with their supporting memories and do not infer missing names from group size.
Stop after one relationship-kind pass and one acquisition-event pass; avoid searching indefinitely for every possible name.

solves: Questions that ask for the names of a person's pets, family members, or group members often miss evidence because generic activity-based searches return no names and relationship memory kinds are excluded from retrieval.
